observations.observation: Returns/unwrap hydrate an ordinary readonly class; raw() keeps the DTO.
Standalone and request hydration return equivalent values.
Default scalar hydration coerces numeric strings, textual bools and numeric titles.
Unknown source fields are not automatically collected into extra.
Missing required nullable field is rejected; explicit null is allowed.
Nullable constructor default accepts both missing and explicit null.
Existing explicit property Cast can reject scalar coercion.
Null bypasses the property Cast; it cannot reject present null here.
Integer overflow already produces a structured hydration error.
From and Nested discriminator work; unknown variants remain raw arrays.
Malformed known variants fail with a nested path and preserved HTTP response.
Diagnostic path uses DTO property name, not the mapped source key batch_id.
Associative collection input is accepted and reindexed by Nested.
Missing unwrap path does not fall back to the root payload.
Null instead of the declared response DTO is rejected.
Malformed JSON preserves the successful HTTP status for outcome classification.
Literal boolean query and omitted nullable recipient work through native declarations.
Declarative Body preserves false, string zero and explicit null with wire policy.
Native fake hydrates DTOs but bypasses the real HttpTransport/PSR-18 boundary.
Client and operation quotas compose locally; operation rejection does not consume the remaining client permit.
